build_hcxvision_model: build a HyperCLOVAX vision-language model for causal LM with CLIP or SigLIP vision encoder
process_image_input: process image pixel inputs through the vision tower and mm projector with anyres postprocessing
process_video_input: process video pixel inputs through the vision tower with adaptive query abstraction for frames
build_cabstractor_projector: build a C-Abstractor neural module that reduces variable-length visual tokens to fixed queries
run_anyres_postprocessing: run anyres postprocessing to unpad, reshape and add newline tokens to image features
